source_findings.finding: Legacy persistent storage ID has sixfields including optional view_metadata.
Legacy save emits magic, protocol,sys_info,obj,serialized_storage_keys, then _write_file(save_size=True,element_size) rawstorages.
When weights_only istrue, nonZIP load routes explicitly to _legacy_load(opened_file,map_location,_weights_only_unpickler,...). No unrestricted pickle module is passed on thisbranch.
Restricted legacy loader parses the first five metadata objects then _set_from_file per listed storage using elementsize; mmap is a ZIP-only capability and mustbeFalse for thispayload.

scope: Static AST/text inspection of independently hash-pinned installed Torch2.7.1CPU source. It establishes availability of the restricted legacy path; actual model loading, time, memory and quality remain untested.
metadata_pickletools_transitive_import_n: Stdlib pickletools may import the stdlib pickle module for opcode definitions. Neither inspector nor decoder calls pickle.load/loads/Unpickler, resolves a checkpoint GLOBAL or importsTorch.
